page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine offering 4 vCPUs across 2 physical Intel Xeon cores at a 2.2 GHz base frequency. Built on an x86_64 architecture with simultaneous multithreading, it features dedicated CPU allocation, 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of shared L3 cache. Supported CPU extensions include AVX, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, whereas AVX-512 and AMX vector extensions are absent. Memory capacity is configured at 16.0 GB RAM, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance includes no bundled local NVMe storage and no GPU accelerators, relying entirely on remote persistent storage for disk operations.

Across compute benchmarks, the e2-standard-4 demonstrates entry-level throughput. Synthetic stress-ng evaluations register 1105.89 points in single-core and 2907.35 points in multi-core routines, placing the instance in the bottom 25 percent of tested systems. Geekbench testing yields scores of 847.0 in single-core and 1906.0 in multi-core, with compilation tasks (2573.0), image processing (1622.0), and text processing (1052.0) all settling in the lower decile. Compression workloads show corresponding limitations, processing gzip compression at 18.75 GB/sec and single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 6.19 GB/sec.

Memory bandwidth measurements achieve 161.16 GB/sec for small cached blocks, while larger uncached transfers reach 24.13 GB/sec read and 20.93 GB/sec write. Workload-specific measurements record Redis SET operations at 4.02 million operations per second and static web throughput at 4.19 GB/sec. Small language model inference on a 135M parameter architecture shows prompt processing at 258.44 tokens per second and text generation at 104.71 tokens per second. The server offers a cost-conscious hardware profile, delivering balanced core-to-memory proportions suitable for standard web serving, staging environments, internal dev tools, and light database tasks where sustained compute density is not mandatory.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Operating on an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor at 2.2 GHz across 2 physical cores, it includes dedicated CPU allocation with 16 MB of L3 cache, standard AVX and AES instructions, but no AVX-512 extensions. The server does not bundle local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators. Benchmark results position the server in the entry-to-intermediate performance bands, with single-core Geekbench at 847.0, multi-core at 1906.0, and static web serving throughput reaching 4.19 GB/sec. Uncached memory read bandwidth tests at 24.13 GB/sec, while Redis SET throughput handles 4.02 million operations per second. The e2-standard-4 provides an economical resource configuration appropriate for general web application backends, dev-test environments, lightweight background workers, and low-traffic database deployments.
